independentAssessment.generatedDiversity: 157 authored pairs, 153 distinct inputs; two fresh offline generator executions reproduced exact recorded output SHA256 625b3df4f279f8c572de1fb259cf7221451148855b50642da8ab2b48910dd4d6 and every authored pair byte-for-byte.
independentAssessment.derivation: A right-facing cow before a left-facing cow creates one unavoidable loss whichever is milked first. Milk left-facing cows left-to-right, then right-facing cows right-to-left to avoid all other losses. Independently compute losses from right-facing position sums: m*n - sum(1-based positions) - m*(m-1)/2, not the worker prefix loop.
independentAssessment.bruteCrossCheck: Physical visibility subset DP minimizes over every milking order for all 510 binary rows of lengths 1..8. All agree with the independently derived position-sum formula.
independentAssessment.sampleMeanings: 0,0,1,0 contains one opposing pair, giving 1; 1,0,1,0,1 contains three, giving 3. Sample cow order 3,4,2,1 indeed loses only one unit.

All 150 fixed-seed adversarial rows and supplied official/upstream-generated rows were independently parsed and solved.

5826106.reason: Always prints 1 instead of computing losses. The valid row 1,0,1,0,1 has three unavoidable opposing pairs; unchanged source prints 1 rather than 3.

6369807.reason: Minimizes an orientation-dependent cost for a single chosen cow, not the accumulated losses of milking all cows. On 1,0,1,0,1 returns 2 while exhaustive order DP and opposing-pair proof give 3.

6369833.reason: Returns only the minimum immediate first-milking cost (ones left plus zeros right), omitting unavoidable later losses. On 1,0,1,0,1 prints 2 rather than 3.

16841684.reason: Recorded first WA 0001 prints debug directions 0,0 and omits the final answer; that alone is NOT its algorithmic qualification. The source additionally has genuinely reversed visibility accounting in its zero-removal branch and quadratic list.index/slicing/scanning/remove work. On authored maximum-size 0033 (100000 ones then 100000 zeros), the zero-removal branch would accumulate 0 rather than 10000000000 and requires quadratic work; the unchanged source actually hits CPU TLE in both recorded and fresh bounded runs. This valid computational-complexity counterexample, not debug formatting or a Python-version/compile failure, qualifies the fifth algorithmically defective source.

46010328.reason: Greedy lowest immediate scare cost with largest-effect tie break is not globally optimal; valid supplied 50-cow row has 416 unavoidable opposing pairs, but this recursive greedy ordering loses 480. Independently derived optimum agrees with all six accepted sources.
